boilerplate_overlaps.passage: Case Prompt - Inter-University Strategy Challenge 2026, Round 2. VoltRide Mobility operates 1,800 dockless electric scooters in Pune and completed 410,000 rides in the last financial year. The founders must decide whether to expand into three tier-2 cities (Nagpur, Indore and Coimbatore) within eighteen months or to deepen operations in Pune by adding battery-swapping stations and corporate subscriptions. Teams must assess market attractiveness, unit economics per scooter, regulatory risk and the funding required for each option. Your submission must recommend one option, justify it with quantitative reasoning, identify the three largest risks and propose mitigation measures for each. Answers should not exceed 1,500 words excluding this prompt. Use only the case exhibits and publicly available sources, and cite every external source you rely on. Submissions will be scored on insight, rigour, feasibility and clarity of communication.
